native_adaptations: Short and _with methods express optional PHP parameters using existing Rust APIs; no new options type or duplicated question engine.
Without a validator ask/hidden return nullable text as Option<String>; validator variants preserve the complete serde_json::Value result.
Style confirm defaults true, CommandIo confirm remains false; source types are distinct.

Global user RuntimeException is retryable; the source Console Exception RuntimeException aborts. Native from_source/new versus explicit from_runtime_source represent those behaviors without PHP inheritance.
Existing JSON/Display model and native async/timeout support remain as previously accepted; no claim of PHP object identity or global VM warning emulation.
